cells.gaps: No source found since October 2023 says an e-procurement system is in service. PPRA said in December 2025 and March 2026 that procurement runs manually (BWA-004, BWA-003), with a national system promised by 2027.
cells.note: PPRA is developing a national e-procurement system with the Finance Ministry (BWA-001, December 2025); the later statements that procurement is manual (BWA-003) do not say the work stopped.
